sloka: ततः तौ देश कालज्ञौ खड्गाभ्याम् एव राघवौ ।अच्छिन्दताम् सुसंहृष्टौ बाहू तस्य अंस देशतः ॥३-७०-८॥
transliteration: tataḥ tau deśa kālajñau khaḍgābhyām eva rāghavau ।acchindatām susaṁhṛṣṭau bāhū tasya aṁsa deśataḥ ॥3-70-8॥

translations.english: Then the agitated brothers, aware of time and space, quickly pulled out their swords and cut off both his arms from the shoulders.
